translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
kaho   kay :  mein subha kay malik ki panah maangta hun ,
her uss cheez kay sharr say jo uss ney peda ki hai ,
aur andheri raat kay sharr say jab woh phel jaye ,
aur unn janon kay sharr say jo ( ganday ki ) girahon mein phoonk maarti hain
aur hasad kernay walay kay sharr say jab woh hasad keray .
